findings.problem: LeaseWorkflow.status uses String instead of a domain enum; mark_sent sets it to a raw literal bypassing all transitions
findings.failure_mode: Any caller can set status to any string (e.g. "sent", "deleted", "banana"), creating illegal lease states that cannot be caught at compile time and making workflow invariants unenforceable
findings.fix: Replace status: String with a LeaseStatus enum (e.g. enum LeaseStatus { Pending, Validated, Sent }) with only valid transitions as methods; remove is_sent bool

findings.problem: Status is stored as pub status: String, a raw primitive that carries no domain semantics or valid-value constraints
findings.failure_mode: Any string value is accepted; callers outside the module can mutate it directly; serialization/deserialization of unknown states has no error path
findings.fix: Replace with a typed enum; derive Serialize/Deserialize; implement TryFrom<String> for infallible parsing at boundaries only

findings.problem: is_validated: bool is a lifecycle boolean that encodes workflow phase without ordering guarantees
findings.failure_mode: A lease can be created with is_validated=true and is_sent=false, or is_validated=true and is_sent=true, or is_validated=false and is_sent=true; all three are semantically illegal but the compiler cannot distinguish them
findings.fix: Replace with a typestate enum or a single status enum variant that owns the lifecycle information (e.g. LeaseStatus::Validated carries optional validation data)

findings.problem: is_sent: bool duplicates status information and creates invalid combinations with the status field
findings.failure_mode: Status can be "pending" while is_sent is true, or status "sent" while is_sent is false; callers can set these independently to inconsistent states
findings.fix: Remove is_sent entirely; derive sent-ness from LeaseStatus::Sent variant; move sent_at_epoch_ms into that variant

findings.problem: sent_at_epoch_ms: Option<u64> is an optional lifecycle field orphaned from the enum variant that should own it
findings.failure_mode: A lease can have sent_at_epoch_ms=Some(123) while status is not Sent, or status is Sent while sent_at_epoch_ms is None; both are illegal but representable
findings.fix: Move sent_at_epoch_ms into the LeaseStatus::Sent variant: LeaseStatus::Sent { sent_at: u64 }; no Option needed because Sent variant requires the timestamp

findings.problem: id: String is a raw primitive with no domain identity guarantees; any string is a valid lease ID
findings.failure_mode: Empty strings, whitespace-only strings, duplicate IDs, and non-ASCII IDs are all accepted; no validation at construction; callers cannot distinguish lease IDs from arbitrary strings
findings.fix: Introduce struct LeaseId(String) with a smart constructor LeaseId::new(id: &str) -> Result<LeaseId, LeaseError> that validates non-empty, bounded length, and optionally format

findings.problem: raw primitives cross the parse boundary without fallible smart constructors; the LeaseWorkflow struct and mark_sent accept and produce unvalidated domain state directly
findings.failure_mode: callers can construct invalid LeaseWorkflow instances directly (empty id, arbitrary status strings, inconsistent bool/option combinations); parse_boundary is violated because hostile inputs reach the core without parsing into trusted types
findings.fix: Replace pub struct LeaseWorkflow with a private struct and a public smart constructor LeaseWorkflow::new(id: LeaseId, initial: LeaseStatus) -> Result<Self, LeaseError>; remove all pub fields; mark_sent becomes a method on LeaseWorkflow returning Result<Self, LeaseError>

findings.problem: mark_sent directly mutates status to a string literal and sets is_sent=true without typestate enforcement or validation
findings.failure_mode: mark_sent can be called on a LeaseWorkflow in any status state (e.g. already Sent, or Deleted), with no transition guards; it also leaves is_validated untouched regardless of workflow requirements
findings.fix: Replace with impl LeaseWorkflow { fn mark_sent(self) -> Result<Self, TransitionError> { ... } } that enforces the source state is Validated (or the appropriate pre-state), returns an error on invalid transitions, and sets the new status via enum variant

findings.problem: All fields of LeaseWorkflow are pub, allowing external mutation of every lifecycle field
findings.failure_mode: Any caller can mutate id, status, is_validated, is_sent, or sent_at_epoch_ms without any validation, bypassing the entire type system
findings.fix: Make all fields private; provide only the smart constructor and immutable getters; transitions go through typed methods

findings.problem: No benchmark, profiler, or allocation evidence exists for any performance claim or allocation behavior
findings.failure_mode: No measurement baseline exists to verify that mark_sent or LeaseWorkflow construction meets latency, throughput, or memory targets; allocation patterns of String id and status are unmeasured
findings.fix: Add criterion or similar benchmark for LeaseWorkflow::new and mark_sent; measure allocation count and bytes via allocators or cargo-flamegraph

findings.problem: No domain error types exist; mark_sent and any smart constructor would have no typed error return
findings.failure_mode: Errors would fall back to panic! or String error messages, violating the typed error taxonomy requirement
findings.fix: Define enum LeaseError { InvalidId, InvalidTransition(LeaseStatus), Allocation } and return Result<T, LeaseError> from all fallible operations

missing_evidence: no benchmark exists for LeaseWorkflow construction or mark_sent performance
no profiler data exists to confirm allocation behavior of String fields
no allocation evidence (try_reserve, Vec::with_capacity usage, or fixed-size alternatives)
no command evidence (cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy, cargo test) has been run or reported
no command-truth evidence that the code matches its intended domain workflow
residual_risk: The LeaseWorkflow struct is entirely unguarded: all fields are pub raw primitives, the state machine is represented by a String plus two booleans, and mark_sent performs direct mutation without transition validation. This creates a high risk of illegal lease states at runtime with zero compile-time protection. A full typestate refactor (enum for status, typestate or single enum for lifecycle, newtypes for IDs, private fields, smart constructors, and typed errors) is required before this code can be considered safe.
